subject: Northbridge Labs — SDK & runtime integration charter
messages:
From: Eleanor Finch <eleanor@northbridge.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Devon Hall <devon.hall@northbridge.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Northbridge Labs x Redwood: SDK integration proposal

Hi Mateo,

Hope you’re well — Eleanor from Northbridge Labs here. We build an embeddable retrieval+runtime for vertical search and are evaluating close integration with Redwood’s inference runtime.

High level ask: we’d like to ship a first-class SDK connector that lets our customers route generation and embedding calls through Redwood (hosted + dedicated) while preserving our telemetry and cost-attribution signals. Key outcomes we care about: predictable latency for short-form retrieval prompts, token-level cost breakdowns, and a simple adapter for LangChain and LlamaIndex users.

Would Redwood be open to a joint integration charter? We put together a short SOW and a telemetry spec (attached) that outline timelines and acceptance criteria. Happy to run a 30–45 minute kickoff next week.

Attachments: NBL_SOW_v1.docx (docx), nbl-runtime-telemetry-spec.json (json)

Best,
Eleanor Finch
Head of Partnerships | Northbridge Labs
https://northbridge.ai
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Eleanor Finch <eleanor@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Devon Hall <devon.hall@northbridge.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-19T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge Labs x Redwood: SDK integration proposal

Eleanor — thanks for reaching out and for the clear brief. Mateo here (Partner Solutions Lead). This is exactly the kind of partner integration we want to prioritize.

A few quick alignment points before kickoff:
- Scope: confirm that the initial integration targets (1) LangChain adapter, (2) LlamaIndex connector, and (3) an optional server-side adapter for your runtime that preserves KV/prefix caching.
- Telemetry: your spec looks good — we’ll need to map your event names to Redwood trace fields. Vanessa (cc’d) will lead the trace-schema work; Kim will scope the SDK packaging/QA.
- Success criteria: two-week sandbox with a sample workload achieving median p95 < 250ms for 128-token prompts and working cost attribution per embedding call.

Propose a kickoff on Tue 2027-05-25 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET. If that works, Vanessa will run a 45m tech walkthrough and we’ll sign the intake SOW.

Next steps for now:
1) Eleanor: confirm kickoff time and share any additional test data (sample embeddings, config).
2) Northbridge: indicate preferred NDA/Security contact for SOC2 artifact request.
3) Redwood: Vanessa will prepare an integration checklist and updated mutual action plan.

Thanks — excited to get started.

— Mateo Alvarez
Partner Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Eleanor Finch <eleanor@northbridge.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Devon Hall <devon.hall@northbridge.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge Labs x Redwood: SDK integration proposal

Thanks Mateo — Tue 5/25 10am PT works for us. Attaching a slightly-expanded SOW and a small CSV with sample embeddings (nb-sample-embeddings.csv).

On security: please route SOC2 + security questionnaire requests to security@northbridge.ai. Devon will be on the kickoff and can loop in ops as needed.

A couple of technical notes so the kickoff can be productive:
- Our runtime currently exposes a plugin hook for token-level logging and a lightweight tracing wrapper we can enable. We’d like Redwood to accept a short-lived API key and pass back a trace_id for cross-system correlation.
- For LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters we’d prefer to maintain our call signatures; if Redwood can provide an adapter shim we’ll mark it as an officially supported connector in our docs.

Attachments: NBL_SOW_v1.docx, nb-sample-embeddings.csv, nbl-runtime-telemetry-spec.json

Best,
Eleanor
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Eleanor Finch <eleanor@northbridge.ai>, Devon Hall <devon.hall@northbridge.ai>
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge Labs x Redwood: SDK integration proposal — kickoff agenda and MAP

Eleanor/Devon — thanks for confirming. Running through pre-kickoff notes and a tentative mutual action plan (MAP) so everyone is aligned. I’ll lead the tech walkthrough on Tue.

Kickoff agenda (45m):
- 0–8m: Introductions & goals (Mateo)
- 8–20m: Northbridge runtime demo (Eleanor) + telemetry hooks overview
- 20–35m: Redwood runtime/adapter architecture and trace mapping (Vanessa)
- 35–45m: Acceptance criteria, sandbox access, and next actions (Kimberly)

Tentative MAP:
- Week 0 (5/25–5/31): Kickoff, sandbox provisioned by Redwood (two GPU nodes), sample workload validated. Deliverables: sandbox access, initial mapping doc.
- Week 1 (6/1–6/7): LangChain adapter prototype + trace schema implementation. Deliverables: adapter PR, trace example logs.
- Week 2 (6/8–6/14): LlamaIndex connector + perf tuning. Deliverables: connector tests, p95 latency report.
- Week 3 (6/15–6/21): Security review & sign-off; docs and co-marketing plan.

Acceptance metrics: p95 < 250ms for 128-token prompts (as Mateo noted); deterministic cost attribution for embedding calls in sample workload; trace_id correlation present across both systems in at least 90% of requests.

Action items (owners):
- Redwood (Vanessa/Kim): provide sandbox link, temporary API keys, and adapter starter template by EOD 5/26.
- Northbridge (Eleanor/Devon): provide sample trace logs if available; confirm security contact and upload SOC2 summary.
- Mateo/Marissa: review SOW and confirm commercial terms if sandbox outcomes meet acceptance.

Shared resources: https://drive.redwood.com/s/nb-integrations/sandbox-kickoff (will populate with MAP, acceptance test harness, and SOW). HubSpot deal HS-78921.

Attachments referenced: integration-checklist-template.md (internal), acceptance-test-harness.zip (internal)

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Devon Hall <devon.hall@northbridge.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, Eleanor Finch <eleanor@northbridge.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge Labs x Redwood: SDK integration proposal — kickoff agenda and MAP

Vanessa — appreciate the detailed MAP. Forwarding a quick note from our security team: we’ll upload a redacted SOC2 summary to security@redwood.ai by Friday and are happy to start the questionnaire.

We’re aligned on the technical milestones and the 2-week sandbox cadence. One ask from our engineering team: can Redwood expose a small test harness endpoint that echoes trace_id + latency metadata so we can validate correlation without hitting production quotas? If so, that would speed up acceptance.

On the kickoff: see quoted text below from Vanessa for the agenda.
